title: Locked in for sixty minutes
situation: Last weekend you and your friends tried an escape room for the first time. You write a blog in English about free-time activities. Write a post about your experience.
situationHu: A barátaiddal először voltál szabadulószobában; írj róla bejegyzést az angol nyelvű blogodba.

explain what the most challenging part was and how your team dealt with it
recommend the activity and give your readers some tips
